role: Stage A local generation, followed by one separate bounded-repair viability review; stopped before Stage C or final masked judge.
classification: Adaptive full-article format-transfer diagnostic of the prior r20 fresh-generation method, outside the original R10 two rounds.
declared_adaptations: Replace the prior business input JSON with the complete article question, original, 18 claims and seven protected literals using the same field order, JSON defaults and chat wrapper.
Change the common answer ceiling and wrapper from 180 to 600 words for a complete title, body and caption.
Change only the decoder new-token upper bound and its matching error text from 512 to 1024; execute with 1024 output tokens.
Use one article in each fresh B/C context instead of the historical two-case batched editor invocations; report actual costs.

runtime.decoder: custom paired-branch decoder, original source hash recorded below
runtime.sampling: CPU multinomial; no top-k, top-p or repetition penalty
runtime.intensity_zero_effect: Disables logit contrast and plausibility masking; not a contrastive decoding intervention.
runtime.one_attempt_enforcement: Exclusive generation-attempt.json created before launch; existing attempt or run directory prevents rerun. Review exact protocol digest and all frozen file hashes before launch.
runtime.context_limit_interpretation: 4096 is the conservative runner validation bound, not the model architecture context size; 1024 is the configured new-output allowance.
runtime.python_interpreter: existing Python 3.12 pilot environment; local path omitted

actual_generation.sampling: CPU multinomial; no top-k, top-p or repetition penalty

article_requirements.format: Complete title, body and separate caption

stage_b.scope: Bounded factual/grammatical repair only, nearest relevant insertion, no general restyling or reconstruction.

stage_c.scope: Pre-edit purpose plan; movement of intact units and justified continuity/fluency repair only.

editing_restrictions.usage: Record actual contexts, exposed model/settings, finish status, elapsed time and available token/cost usage per stage; unavailable remains unavailable.

quality_gate.input: Reader purpose, complete original and source notes, all claims/literals, exact fixed R10 baseline and exact frozen candidate, file SHA-256 for each; random opaque arm labels recorded privately by coordinator.
quality_gate.required_verdict: Both arms must pass correctness, all claims/literals, relevance, necessary qualifications, professional tone, title/body/caption completeness, fluent article suitability, length and additions check. Candidate must have no readability/preference loss against baseline.
quality_gate.historical_numbers_in_source: Historical confidence triplets required by article are source facts, not new outcome leakage; do not redact them.
quality_gate.any_failure: Retain artifacts and stop without scans, post-review repair, regeneration, replacement or eased criteria.

failure_policy: Zero retries or replacement outputs. Stop on execution/time failure, nonviable bounded repair, any factual/fluency/suitability failure, unavailable compatible measurement, or budget breach. Retain every available artifact; do not loosen quality criteria.

cost.note: Local generation used existing weights. Editor runtime did not expose token/cost or full elapsed receipts; zero cloud generation cost is not zero total computation cost.
